english_fact_card.where: Royal Albert Edward Infirmary, Wigan, Greater Manchester

content:c343d8f91dadd2bc53161ea524315d58.title: Eccles: Homes will be 'completely dwarfed' by warehouses
content:c343d8f91dadd2bc53161ea524315d58.english_reader_card: Eccles residents say a 60ft warehouse development will dwarf their homes and have set up a campaign group. The site on Lankro Way was approved in 2022, and concerns include lack of consultation and potential contamination.

english_fact_card.what_happened: Residents in Eccles, Salford, are concerned that a large warehouse development will dwarf their homes. The largest warehouse is set to be 60ft (18m) high. The site is a former chemical plant on Lankro Way, close to the Manchester Ship Canal.
